messages:
maria_g: FYI — after the CNI post-upgrade last night we're seeing intermittent packet loss for east-west traffic between GPU pods in west2. High tail latency for redis/rpc calls.
kevin_l: Ugh. Which CNI and roll? did we push cilium 1.20?
maria_g: Yes, upgrade from cilium 1.19.2 -> 1.20.0 at ~02:10 UTC. Canary showed fine but after ~30m the gpu node pool started showing packet drops.
anish_r: I saw RDMA handshake retries on a subset of nodes around the same window. Logs: `mlx5: rdma: cm: rearm qp failed: -110` and `ib_rc: send completion timeout`
infra-bot: ALERT gpu-west2-nodes: network_error_rate=4.7% (threshold 1.0%) — triggered at 1749987800
maria_g: Quick repro: from pod-a (gpu) -> pod-b (gpu) `kubectl exec -c app pod-a -- iperf3 -c 10.120.34.22 -t 10` shows 15-20% packet loss and jitter spike.
kevin_l: Can you paste MTU and if offloading differs? run `ip link show` and `ethtool -k` on host and pod netns. Also check if vxlan/geneve mtu changed.
maria_g: Host eth0 MTU is 9000, veth in pod shows 1450, tunnel devices show 1400. Ran `kubectl exec` and did `ping -M do -s 1400 pod-ip` -> fragmentation/icmp messages.
anish_r: That matches RDMA flakiness — larger PMTU across overlay could be getting clamped unexpectedly after the Cilium bump. I saw kernel message `NETDEV_CHANGE: geneve0: lowering mtu to 1400` around rollout time.
kevin_l: Hmm. Could be a tunnel offload or GSO/GRO handling change in 1.20. Any changes to bpf programs or skb handling in release notes?
maria_g: 1.20 mentions support for offload-aware encapsulation; maybe default behavior changed. I also captured `tcpdump -i geneve0` and saw lots of ICMP frag-needed.
oncall-matt: I'm on call, have put the cluster in elevated monitoring and paused new training jobs to limit blast radius.
kevin_l: Action: 1) Quarantine canary nodes (drain new pods to non-gpu) 2) Roll back Cilium on one affected k8s nodepool to 1.19 and test east-west 3) Run controlled iperf + RDMA handshake test. I'll own #2.
maria_g: I ran a quick rollback on one canary (gpu-west2-canary-3) and after restart pod-pairs passed iperf with <1% loss. I can share the logs.
deploy-bot: Rollback job started: cilium downgrade on gpu-west2-canary-3 (job id rb-2024-11-06-03)
anish_r: If rollback confirms, we should patch 1.20 with offload/GSO toggles or hold the rollout. Also need an MTU probe as part of preflight.
kevin_l: Agreed. Add a preflight script: probe PMTU for overlay endpoints and check for kernel MTU clamp logs.
maria_g: I'll open an incident and document repro steps + dumps (`tcpdump`, `dmesg`, `iperf`) and assign follow-ups. Short-term: pause rest of 1.20 rollout and schedule emergency patch window.
oncall-matt: Noted. I'll update status page and wake infra lead if rollback fails.
maria_g: Thanks — will post incident link here when created. :thumbsup:
kevin_l: Thanks — waving flag for perf team to review offload changes in 1.20.
anish_r: Also check if any Kubernetes CNI MTU defaults got overridden by daemonset args; seen that before where max-packet-size was set lower at creation time.
maria_g: Will validate daemonset args + cloud route MTU and follow up. Keeping this thread for updates.
